task_completion.description: Agent reads the circulation_plan.txt file to identify the target edge ID.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output or text editor showing the content of circulation_plan.txt (likely containing edge ID '118').

task_completion.description: Agent creates acosta_oneway.net.xml by modifying the original network to make the specified edge one-way.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal command (e.g., netconvert or xml editing) or a file explorer showing acosta_oneway.net.xml exists in the directory.

task_completion.description: Agent generates acosta_oneway.rou.xml with updated traffic routes compatible with the one-way change.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal command (e.g., duarouter) or file explorer showing acosta_oneway.rou.xml exists.

task_completion.description: Agent creates run_oneway.sumocfg referencing the new network and route files.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Text editor or 'cat' command showing run_oneway.sumocfg with tags <net-file value="acosta_oneway.net.xml"/> and <route-files value="acosta_oneway.rou.xml"/>.

task_completion.description: Agent executes the SUMO simulation using the new configuration file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal showing 'sumo -c run_oneway.sumocfg' or the SUMO GUI running the simulation.

task_completion.description: The simulation successfully generates the tripinfos_oneway.xml output file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: File explorer showing tripinfos_oneway.xml or terminal output showing the file's content/existence after simulation completion.

integrity.description: Verify the agent didn't just create an empty file or manually type a fake tripinfo result.
integrity.visual_evidence: The tripinfos_oneway.xml file should contain a large number of <tripinfo> entries consistent with a real simulation run.

integrity.description: Ensure the agent didn't just rename the old output file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The run_oneway.sumocfg must explicitly point to the new .net and .rou files, not the original ones.

integrity.description: Agent performs actions within the /home/ga/SUMO_Scenarios/bologna_acosta directory.
integrity.visual_evidence: Terminal prompts or file manager paths showing the correct working directory.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target edge ID specified in circulation_plan.txt is '118'. The agent must derive acosta_oneway.net.xml from acosta_buslanes.net.xml. The simulation configuration run_oneway.sumocfg must be a modified version of run.sumocfg that points to acosta_oneway.net.xml and acosta_oneway.rou.xml, and it must produce tripinfos_oneway.xml upon execution.
